_note: Hand-authored chain snapshot for sun-zone-done. Sound design IS composition — chains ship in the snapshot, not as a post-push mix pass. Uses preset_query for cross-machine portable resolution (Sweep B). Tempo 180 / 4/4 / E (Em); 3 returns (Plate / Room / DubDelay); 7 tracks (6 instrument + 1 empty vocal bus pre-wired with sends).

returns.name: Plate
returns._note: Plate-character reverb. Reggae spaces, lead voice, future vocals.

returns.name: Room
returns._note: Short room reverb. Metal tightness, snare body.

returns.name: DubDelay
returns._note: Tape-character delay. Reggae transitions, organ skanks, WHACK tail. Tempo-synced (set dotted-8th post-load for dub feel).

tracks.name: 01 Drums
tracks._note: Hot Rod Kit — punchy rock-leaning Drum Rack, full GM-style pad mapping (kick=36 / rim=37 / snare=38 / hat=42 / open=46 / crash=49 / ride=51). Velocity authoring carries the genre dynamic. One-drop pattern for reggae, gallop+double-kick for metal.

devices.name: Boom in E
devices._note: Drum Buss preset tuned for the song's E tonic — bus glue + character, baked-in authorship.

tracks.name: 02 Bass
tracks._note: Tension modeled electric bass — same instrument, articulation flips between fingered reggae round and palm-muted metal tight. Mud killer: NO sends.

devices.name: EQ Eight
devices._note: HPF below 35 Hz; gentle low-mid bump at 200 Hz for body. Tune post-load.

devices.name: Gritty Bass
devices._note: Bass saturation is composition, not a mix afterthought.

devices.name: Compressor
devices._note: Light, ~4:1, fast attack — tames metal palm-mute spikes without strangling reggae dynamics.

tracks.name: 03 Rhythm Gtr
tracks._note: One modeled Strat-style guitar; Amp's Type+Drive parameters automated per section (Clean for reggae skanks, Heavy/Metalic for metal gallops). Same instrument, two amp states.

devices.name: Amp
devices._note: Defaults to Clean type for reggae. Type and Gain parameters automated per section.

devices.name: EQ Eight
devices._note: Cut mud below 100 Hz, presence boost at 3 kHz.

tracks.name: 04 Organ
tracks._note: Hammond-style drawbar organ. Bandstand preset has the right reggae-skank bite. Drops out entirely in metal sections (clip-level — no notes).

devices.name: Organ Bandstand
devices._note: Wavetable-based Organ Bandstand rack (modern version). Pattern duplicates with Instrument Rack root — path_prefix disambiguates.

devices.name: Chorus-Ensemble
devices._note: Bakes Leslie-cabinet shimmer into the organ tone. Authorship, not mix-time tweak.

devices.name: EQ Eight
devices._note: HPF below 200 Hz (stays above the vocal hole). Gentle high boost for skank presence.

tracks.name: 05 Lead Voice
tracks._note: PLACEHOLDER for future vocals. Mono Wavetable lead carries the vocal melody in E3-E4 (up to G4 in metal shouts). Saturator+Comp pre-applies the vocal-bus treatment so when real vocals arrive the FX chain matches. See decisions/05-vocals-and-placeholder-lead.md.

devices.name: Wavetable
devices._note: Bare Wavetable instance. Configure post-load: mono mode on, glide ~30ms, saw wavetable, slight unison detune. Per-section patch variation: warm filtered saw for reggae, brighter cut-through for metal.

devices.name: EQ Eight
devices._note: Carved for E3-E4 register; presence at 2-3 kHz.

tracks.name: 06 Counter-Melody
tracks._note: PERMANENT layer — stays when vocals arrive. Operator bell-FM sits B4-E5 (above vocal register). Higher reverb/delay puts it slightly behind the vocal in depth.

devices.name: Operator
devices._note: Bare Operator. Configure post-load: FM algorithm with bell-like ratio (e.g., A=1, B=3.5 mod into A), short envelopes, slight modulation.

devices.name: EQ Eight
devices._note: HPF below 400 Hz; presence in 4-6 kHz.

devices.name: Compressor
devices._note: Light, holds the part steady against the placeholder lead.

tracks.name: 07 Vocal Bus
tracks._note: EMPTY — pre-wired for future vocals. Send levels match Lead Voice so vocals slot into the same spatial placement. No instrument/devices yet; vocal-tracking session adds EQ/Comp/De-Esser to taste. When real vocals arrive, sidechain sources (organ + rhythm gtr) repoint from Lead Voice -> Vocal Bus.
